title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1974-10-19
source: Lineage: 16 track "truck monitor mix" > 2 track mixdown reel > R @ 3 3/4 ips. > FLAC; Transfer info: Akai GX636 direct tape head output > Bottlehead tube tape pre w/ a pair of Telefunken tubes circa 1960 > Apogee Mini Me 24/96 > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering  > FLAC; Tranfered October 2014 by Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: Nice soundboard capture featuring Bob's western storytelling and Jerry's old‑time train tunes, but track labeling gets scrambled after song 12.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clear, well‑balanced soundboard quality and the set’s focus on Bob Weir’s narrative “western” songs and Jerry Garcia’s vintage train‑song vibe. However listeners should be aware that the track numbering is misaligned after the twelfth cut, which can make navigation confusing.

ai_rating.rationale: One enthusiastic five‑star review highlights both performance and sound quality; a second points out track‑labeling errors, giving a mixed overall impression with limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑mixed recording praised by listeners; however, track labeling is incorrect after track 12, causing navigation issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall set appreciated for its storytelling focus, but the post‑track‑12 labeling mistake disrupts the flow for listeners using the track list.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Old‑timey train songs are specifically praised.
band_member_comments.Bob: Western story songs receive particular love.
